changelog: LSA Leads: duplicate protection — a lead whose phone already has an active Roofr job (appointment scheduled, proposal out, install scheduled, etc.) is flagged '⚠️ Already in Roofr' with a link to the job card and dropped from auto-dial, so no one cold-calls an existing customer
Flagged duplicates stay in the queue and can be closed without dialing: opening the card shows Booked / Unqualified / Other so a rep verifies against the job card and dispositions it in one click
